I will manage this plot in a simple way because inputs are expensive, and on a big intercropped plot like mine I cannot afford to buy much fertilizer or enough manure for all of it. For this season I will mostly rely on my own seed and family work, and I may bring in some hired labor for the heavier jobs. I do not expect to irrigate, and I will not use chemicals unless there is a serious problem.
